title: Child Social Media Message
scenario: An adult account asks your child to keep messages secret from parents.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Child Social Media Message: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Secrecy from caregivers is a serious safety warning.
